SELECT
    sumMap(number, toString(number % 2)),
    avgMap(number, toString(number % 2))
FROM numbers(3)

SELECT
    regr_avgx(y, x),
    regr_avgy(y, x),
    regr_count(y, x),
    regr_intercept(y, x),
    regr_r2(y, x),
    regr_slope(y, x),
    regr_sxx(y, x),
    regr_sxy(y, x),
    regr_syy(y, x)
FROM
(
    SELECT
        number AS x,
        (number * 2) + 1 AS y
    FROM numbers(3)
)

SELECT *
FROM
(
    SELECT
        number,
        r
    FROM
    (
        SELECT *
        FROM
        (
            SELECT *
            FROM numbers(2)
        ) AS a
        NATURAL LEFT JOIN
        (
            SELECT
                0 AS number,
                'R' AS r
        ) AS b
    )
)
ORDER BY number ASC

SELECT
    v,
    toTypeName(v)
FROM
(
    SELECT 7 / 2 AS v
    SETTINGS sql_compatible_division_for_integers = 0
)
SETTINGS sql_compatible_division_for_integers = 1

WITH
    c AS MATERIALIZED
    (
        SELECT number
        FROM numbers(3)
    )
SELECT sum(number)
FROM c

CREATE TABLE t
(
    `x` Int32,
    PROJECTION p
    (
        SELECT x
        WHERE x > 0
        ORDER BY x
    )
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
ORDER BY x

SELECT
    number,
    sum(number) OVER (ORDER BY number ASC GROUPS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING)
FROM numbers(3)
ORDER BY number ASC

SELECT *
FROM
(
    SELECT number
    FROM
    (
        SELECT *
        FROM
        (
            SELECT *
            FROM numbers(4)
        )
        WHERE number > 1
    )
)
ORDER BY number ASC

SELECT sumMap(map('a', number, 'b', number * 2))
FROM numbers(3)
